# Repository Pattern E2E Test

This is a real integration test for the repository pattern.

## logo
![Baidu logo](https://www.baidu.com/img/PCtm_d9c8750bed0b3c7d089fa7d55720d6cf.png)

## Overview

The repository pattern centralizes database access.
We introduced three repositories:
- ChunkRepository
- VectorRepository
- GraphMetadataRepository

## Benefits

1. Centralized query management
2. Easier testing with mocks
3. Consistent error handling
